Respondent  ( IA No.131047/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT and IA No.131048/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. )
 Date : 21-07-2023
This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HRISHIKESH ROY  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PANKAJ MITHAL

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Sandeep Sudhakar Deshmukh, AOR  Mr. Nishant Sharma, Adv.
 Mr. Tushar D.bhelkar, Adv.
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Heard Mr. Sandeep Sudhakar Deshmukh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

The counsel submits that the criminal case was erroneously quashed by the Division Bench of the High Court under the impugned judgmemt dated Date: 2023.07.22 27.03.2023 by pointing out that the regular criminal case has since been registered under Section 420, 323 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

The counsel then points out that the criminal case pertains to cheating in connection with Chandrasekhar Ramesh Galande vs Satish Gajanan Mulik on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107290312/
1 fraudulent sale deed and therefore the High Court should not have ordered for quahsment of the FIR.
Issue notice, returnable in four weeks.
Dasti, in addition, is permitted.
(DEEPAK JOSHI) (KAMLESH RAWAT)
